dimensions.assessment: Affects visitors and local recreational users of the Glen Canyon National Recreation Area in Arizona and Utah.
dimensions.evidence: allows off-road vehicles to be used in certain areas of the Glen Canyon National Recreation Area

dimensions.assessment: Reverses specific administrative restrictions on off-road vehicle routes and shoreline access.
dimensions.evidence: nullifies the rule issued by the National Park Service... titled Glen Canyon National Recreation Area; Motor Vehicles

dimensions.assessment: No direct federal spending or revenue changes are specified in the text.
Voids a single federal agency rule governing vehicle use within a specific national recreation area.
dimensions.evidence: such rule shall have no force or effect

dimensions.assessment: Permanently invalidates the specified rule unless subsequent rulemaking or legislation occurs.

importance_detail.rationale: This joint resolution nullifies a specific National Park Service rule regarding motor vehicle and off-road vehicle use in the Glen Canyon National Recreation Area, altering local recreational access rules.
